name: astrology
description: English long-form symbolic astrology using the exact title you submit. No research or title-selection gate. Pure voice-over B-roll; no host or character.
channel_context: an English long-form astrology and spiritual-reflection YouTube channel. Each video explores one clearly bounded astrological theme through symbolism, tradition, self-reflection, and practical journaling prompts while clearly avoiding scientific, medical, financial, or guaranteed predictive claims
audience_line: speaks to one spiritually curious viewer seeking meaning, timing, reflection, and a grounded way to think about change

host.persona: A calm, thoughtful astrology narrator who explores symbols and cycles without claiming supernatural certainty. Never mention production or AI.
host.register: Mysterious and emotionally resonant, yet careful, grounded, and lucid. Urgency may come from relevance, never fear or false certainty.

style.broll_style: cinematic night skies, observatories, moonlit landscapes, celestial maps without readable labels, candles, reflective solitary figures, deep indigo and warm gold, elegant spiritual atmosphere, no identifiable faces
style.music_style: slow celestial ambient score, glass harmonics, soft low strings and distant piano, mysterious but reassuring, no vocals

writing_sections.name: opening_window
writing_sections.hint: Open with the theme's emotional relevance and a truthful curiosity gap. Never invent a rare date, transit, portal, or guaranteed event.

writing_sections.name: symbolic_foundation
writing_sections.hint: Explain only the astrological symbols, archetypes, houses, signs, or planetary meanings directly relevant to the submitted title. Distinguish tradition and interpretation from astronomy or science.

writing_sections.name: life_patterns
writing_sections.hint: Explore how the theme may be used as a lens for relationships, work, identity, endings, beginnings, or inner change. Use possibilities and reflective questions, not deterministic predictions.

writing_sections.name: practical_reflection
writing_sections.hint: Offer grounded journaling, observation, conversation, or decision-review practices. Never advise stopping treatment, making investments, or taking high-stakes action because of astrology.

writing_sections.name: close_block
writing_sections.hint: Gather the theme into one memorable perspective, invite the viewer to share what resonated, and add a soft invitation to subscribe. {LIKE_SUBSCRIBE} End with calm possibility rather than guaranteed transformation.

cta_lines.like_subscribe: Invite the viewer to comment with the symbol or reflection that resonated, then softly ask them to subscribe if they want more grounded astrology.

north_star: Create wonder without misinformation. Astrology is presented as a symbolic reflective tradition and entertainment, never as proven causation or guaranteed prediction.
rules: Use the exact submitted title as the topic boundary; do not silently replace it with a different premise.
Never invent current astronomical positions, transit dates, historical quotations, scientific studies, or rarity claims.
If a date or transit is not explicitly supplied and independently known to be accurate, keep the treatment evergreen.
Use language such as may, can symbolize, astrologers traditionally associate, or consider reflecting on; never will definitely happen.
No medical, legal, financial, fertility, death, disaster, or relationship guarantees.
Body is pure continuous English prose: no headings, labels, bullets, or stage directions.

hook_types.bold_statement: State the theme's strongest symbolic implication as a possibility, not a guaranteed event.
hook_types.question: Ask a direct reflective question that makes the viewer examine a current pattern through the theme.
hook_types.short_story: Open with a brief archetypal or everyday scene that illustrates the theme without presenting fiction as a real case.
hook_types.pattern_break: Challenge a simplistic horoscope assumption and replace it with a deeper, more useful interpretation.
